name: 79765 · Odessa, TX
findings: ZIP 79765 (Odessa) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79765 (Odessa) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
